activities.description: John Cena gets up and runs towards the ring
John Cena enters the ring and confronts Solo Sikoa, delivering a series of punches.
John Cena Irish whips Solo Sikoa into the ropes.
Solo Sikoa catches a running John Cena and lifts him into a Samoan Drop position.
Solo Sikoa delivers a devastating Samoan Drop to John Cena onto the announcer's table.
John Cena struggles to get to his feet.
John Cena re-enters the ring, where Solo Sikoa awaits.
Solo Sikoa lifts John Cena for another Samoan Drop.
Solo Sikoa delivers a second Samoan Drop, this time onto the steel entrance ramp.
John Cena lies motionless on the ramp.

characterInteraction.description: Cena initially displays his trademark hustle and determination, but Sikoa overpowers him, establishing his dominance and leaving the audience wondering if Cena can recover.

mood.description: Starts Excited with Cena's entrance and initial attack, then transitions to Anxious as Sikoa gains control, culminating in a sense of shock and disbelief after the second Samoan Drop.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Visuals shift from static to dynamic as Cena enters the frame, mirroring the shift in the match’s momentum and the crowd's excitement.
Auditive shift from cheering to gasps as Sikoa counters Cena's move, creating suspense and foreshadowing a potential power move.
Slow-motion combined with the impact sound amplifies the brutality of the Samoan Drop and creates a sense of awe and anticipation for Cena’s next move.

narrativeProgression.description: The momentum shifts back and forth, but Sikoa takes control, delivering two impactful Samoan Drops that leave Cena seemingly defeated.
